scope: Equal-depth verification for a private inhabited modern apartment building, a municipally acquired heritage quinta entering restoration, and a multi-district compact-city research construct that must collapse to one field scene.

sources.supports: Documents García Bryce's 1963 building, plans, street entry, current residential use, good recorded conservation and maintenance.
A 2025 García Bryce exhibition confirms archival drawings and the building's place in his work; it does not prove current resident access.
The practice lists an intervention at Edificio Álvarez Calderón, but scope/date are not explicit and cannot be treated as verified current alteration.
MML completed acquisition of the 41,050.86 m² Quinta Heeren in October 2025 through Prolima, enabling public restoration planning.
A February 2026 bibliographic alert records contemporary reporting that recovery would respect heritage value; it is secondary indexing, not proof of completed works or access.

sources.publisher: Ministerio de Cultura / Congreso del Perú
sources.supports: Official presentation documents longstanding ownership/restoration constraints; historical context does not establish 2026 construction state.
Official metropolitan zoning history records repeated land-use adjustments affecting Pueblo Libre, Lince and adjacent central districts, supporting block-level transition research.

A March 2026 council act records a contested medium-density-to-commercial rezoning request, proving current block-scale development pressure without endorsing that specific address as the final scene.
The IMP registry links district zoning to PlanMet 2040; it supports a research framework, never a single photographic location by itself.

contradictions: CAMMP records current residential use and good conservation, but its assessment date is not a 2026 condition survey.
A professional intervention is listed without explicit scope/date and cannot be presented as verified transformation.
The building is private housing; plans and archives never authorize access or observation into dwellings.
composition_questions: Can the portico, brick/concrete mass and current entry gesture show how a 1963 multifamily preserved neighborhood scale while concentrating housing?
Which architectural-award framing, façade symmetry, parked car or private window turns the image into modernist cataloguing or surveillance?
Does an archival public repeat reveal a current street/entry relationship, or is resident life invisible without intrusion?

source_truth.answer: José García Bryce's 1963 Edificio Álvarez Calderón at no. 590 remains a private residential building documented through plans, archival photographs and a current CAMMP record.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A portico, articulated brick/concrete volumes, terraces, stair core and service orientation reconcile multifamily density with domestic scale and privacy.

current_life.answer: Residents enter, leave, receive, overlook, maintain and screen; actual rhythms, alterations and street-edge visibility require privacy-first field observation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Enter, return, receive, wait, maintain, screen and pass are credible. A quiet portico can express collective domestic expectation without showing residents.

architectural_causality.answer: Portico, setback, articulated volumes and stair core mediate street-to-collective-home transition while preserving privacy and neighborhood scale.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Clean frontal elevation and archival modernist praise dominate. The underused relation is the current public threshold negotiating collective domestic arrival.

light_material_geometry.answer: Lateral light can reveal brick/concrete warmth, terrace depth and portico hierarchy; abstract grids without current domestic cause fail.

position_then_optics.answer: Test archival public repeat, portico tangent and block-context reverse. Start 35 mm for street/building, 50 mm for entry and avoid 85 mm toward windows/terraces.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Remain on public pavement, never target windows/balconies or wait on residents, hide addresses/security details, seek consent for identifiable entry gestures and kill private-access proofs.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when collective-housing geometry visibly shapes a current public-to-domestic transition. Modernist façade, fame or invasive resident observation fails.

A_STRUCTURE.expected_action: Clear interval reveals collective entry order
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude cars, address and private windows

B_HABITAR.position: Public oblique where portico mediates anonymous/consenting arrival
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: No face, key, package or interior

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Public lateral reverse showing collective mass within current low-rise street

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Public oblique where brick, concrete and portico shadow overlap

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Public diagonal joining neighborhood approach, collective portico and residential mass
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Passing, pausing and entering occupy layers

contradictions: Municipal acquisition is verified, but restoration start, phase, completion and public access are not established by a current primary works record.
2026 restoration reporting is preserved as corroborated bibliographic evidence, not verified site status.
Future public/cultural use cannot be presented as current inhabitation.
composition_questions: Can the public enclosure, visible internal axis and current acquisition/restoration trace show a private elite quinta becoming contested civic heritage?
Which ruin texture, ghost story, construction worker or picturesque façade turns the frame into decay/restoration reportage?
Does a legal public-edge position reveal old internal order meeting present city movement, or is entry essential and therefore unavailable?

source_truth.answer: MML completed acquisition of the large Barrios Altos Quinta Heeren in October 2025 through Prolima; current restoration phase and access remain unresolved.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A gated landscaped residential enclave organized villas and internal circulation apart from the surrounding city; exact accessible elements require current survey.

current_life.answer: Municipal custody, assessment and proposed recovery replace former private control; actual workers, residents, stabilization and public programs are unverified.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Guard, inspect, document, stabilize, pass, wait and look are credible. Closure can be meaningful only when the internal order and present public claim remain visible.

architectural_causality.answer: Enclosure, gate and internal axis separate the large historic enclave from dense Barrios Altos streets; acquisition may begin changing that threshold.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Abandoned mansion, decay and restoration announcement dominate. The underused relation is the closed historic urban system meeting ordinary street life and public ownership.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can unify wall/gate/street layers; low light can expose depth through a legal opening. Ruin texture or romantic decay without civic transition fails.

position_then_optics.answer: Test public gate-axis view, enclosure tangent and neighborhood reverse. Start 35 mm for city/enclave, 50 mm for threshold and avoid telephoto into restricted interiors.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify barriers/works with Prolima, never enter or photograph workers/residents without permission, avoid instability and ghost/decay sensationalism, and default to public edge.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when enclosure and internal order visibly meet current public ownership/street life. Ruin beauty, announced restoration or historical caption fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Public gate-axis view holding enclosure, internal depth and street edge
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude ruin fragments and signage dominance

B_HABITAR.position: Public edge where ordinary pedestrians pass the municipally controlled gate
B_HABITAR.expected_action: Pass, pause and look occur at threshold

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Public reverse from dense neighborhood street toward enclosure/internal axis
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Local movement crosses historic enclave boundary

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Public oblique where gate/enclosure shadow reveals internal depth

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Public diagonal joining Barrios Altos movement, acquired gate and historic internal axis
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Passing, pausing and controlled entry/absence occupy layers

contradictions: The three-district transect is a research method, not a one-frame candidate; it must collapse to one exact block before field promotion.
One Lince zoning dispute proves current pressure at one address, not a general condition across Pueblo Libre, Lince and Surquillo.
District zoning documents do not prove built form, resident behavior or safe camera positions on the shoot date.
composition_questions: Which single block makes a zoning/density transition visibly channel one present sidewalk, threshold or service verb?
Which tower-versus-house cliché, traffic, signage or multi-frame comparison substitutes generic densification for architectural causality?
Can one public 35 mm position hold old plot grain, new mass and one changed human route, or must the transect be rejected as an essay?

source_truth.answer: Official zoning history and a 2026 Lince decision verify active land-use pressure; the named three-district transect remains a comparative research construct until one block is selected.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Fine-grained residential plots, neighborhood commerce and district streets historically distributed domestic/service life at low-to-medium density; exact block contract must be researched after selection.

current_life.answer: Residents, workers, deliveries and pedestrians negotiate redevelopment and zoning pressure; no verb is attributed to all three districts.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Enter, deliver, wait, cross, park, sell and contest are plausible at a selected block. Generic city movement is insufficient until directly observed.

architectural_causality.answer: Plot width, setbacks, tower podiums, retained houses and mixed-use thresholds can redirect sidewalk/service behavior, but only one verified device may anchor the final scene.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Old-house/new-tower contrast and skyline transects dominate. The underused relation is one ground-level threshold where density change visibly alters a daily verb.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can unify heterogeneous fabric; low light can expose setback/plot seams. Visual contrast without causal current use fails.

position_then_optics.answer: At one selected block test frontage tangent, opposite-side section and corner reverse. Start 35 mm for plot/mass/use, 50 mm for threshold and reject telephoto skyline comparison.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Select and source one block, verify current works/access, stay public, protect residents and workers, avoid windows/construction risk, and kill the candidate if multiple districts/frames are required.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes only when one exact block makes density transformation change one present verb. A three-district route, collage or generic old/new contrast fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Opposite public sidewalk at one preselected block holding old plot, new mass and shared ground edge

B_HABITAR.position: Public block position where changed threshold affects delivery/entry/waiting
B_HABITAR.expected_action: Adult changes route at old/new frontage seam

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Public corner reverse emphasizing ground/sidewalk rather than tower crown

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Public oblique where old wall/new podium shadow crosses sidewalk

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: One public diagonal joining retained plot, new mass and altered daily route
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Approach, detour and entry/delivery occupy layers
